content.text: Intent
A simple register of people: any signed-in user can create, browse, edit and delete a person's basic contact details. This is a minimal, self-contained reference entity with no process around it.
Scope
IN:
A Person entity with basic contact fields (name, email, date of birth).
The entity's standard search screen and edit form.
OUT (non-goals):
No relationship to other entities (no employer, address book, or household links).
No import/export, no lifecycle states, no roles or permissions beyond the platform's signed-in-user default.
Scenarios
None — the bean's standard screens (create, browse, edit, delete) cover every journey.
Requirements
None — every rule is carried by the bean table.
Data model
bean: Person
No relationships. Email is unique across all people when present; a person without an email is allowed. A date of birth cannot lie in the future.
User interface
The bean's search screen and edit form.
Dependencies
None — new entity, nothing to depend on.
Constraints
Considered, none apply: authorization (platform default — any signed-in user), performance, volume, availability, audit, privacy, locale, cost.
Acceptance criteria
None — the platform's generated tests cover the table rules.
Migration & compatibility
None — new entity, nothing to migrate.
Artifacts
A Person entity with its standard search screen and edit form.
Derived from the Data model
Implied by the bean blocks in the Data model and regenerated by the platform - do not edit this block; author above it what the catalog cannot derive.

Person - persistence.entity (persistence): The entity class with its builder, its descriptor + jsontype entry, its migration and table, and its tests; the descriptor is authored at spec time as the bean's entry in the spec's entity_descriptors.json.
Person - observer.sheet (observer): The observer sheet: the entity's only remote surface, reads and writes.

Person - ui.defaultForm (ui): The default form of one row, rendered wherever the row is viewed or edited: its layout JS, authored at spec time as the spec folder's ui/{qualified-descriptor-name}.js and shipped beside the entity class.
Person.email - validation.rule (persistence): unique when present - enforced on save and covered by a generated test
Person.dateOfBirth - validation.rule (persistence): max(today) - enforced on save and covered by a generated test

None.
